lines.zh: 巨大的身躯在地面上震颤。
lines.en: Rumbling footsteps on the ground.

lines.zh: 粗壮的腿步履缓慢而沉重。
lines.en: Heavy steps with powerful legs.
Large tail swaying back and forth.

lines.zh: 锋利的牙齿咬合着坚硬的骨头。
lines.en: Sharp teeth crunching hard bones.

lines.zh: 长长的脖子在草丛中寻找猎物。
lines.en: Long neck scans through the grass.
Powerful body moves slowly.
Low growl echoes through the valley.
Swing claws, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 俯视下方，猎物近在眼前。
lines.en: Look down, prey within sight.

lines.zh: 缓缓转身，寻找新的猎物。
lines.en: Slowly turn, seeking new prey.
Three-toed prints sink into the mud.

lines.zh: 尾巴甩开草丛，惊起飞虫。
lines.en: My tail parts the brush and scatters flies.

lines.zh: 沿着河岸搜寻猎物的气味。
lines.en: I track prey scent along the riverbank.

lines.zh: 两条后腿撑起沉重的身体。
lines.en: Two hind legs hoist my heavy body.

lines.zh: 巨大的身躯懒洋洋地躺着。
lines.en: Large body lying lazily.
Lazily shaking head.

lines.zh: 静静注视着周围的环境。
lines.en: Quietly staring around.

lines.zh: 粗大的尾巴懒散地摆动。
lines.en: Large tail swinging lazily.
One low growl and the birds scatter.

lines.zh: 眼睛半闭，享受片刻宁静。
lines.en: Half-closed eyes, enjoying peace.
Slowly turning head.

lines.zh: 长长的舌头懒懒地伸展。
lines.en: Long tongue lazily extending.
Occasionally licking claws.
Breathing calmly, feeling the breeze.
I lie in the sun to warm my back.
I gape to cool down, tongue flicking.

lines.zh: 把鼻子埋进泥里蹭了蹭。
lines.en: I bury my snout in mud and rub.

lines.zh: 盯着水面里自己的影子。
lines.en: I stare at my reflection in the water.

lines.zh: 巨大的眼睛注视着玩家。
lines.en: Large eyes staring at player.

lines.zh: 我把吻部凑近，嗅你的鞋。
lines.en: I bring my snout close to sniff your boots.

lines.zh: 我这张大嘴，生来就是咬的。
lines.en: This big jaw of mine was born to bite.

lines.zh: 低吼从喉咙深处滚出来。
lines.en: A growl rolls up from deep in my throat.
Extend long neck, searching for player.
Teeth clashing, making threat.
Growl becomes louder.
Staring at player, hungry eyes.
Growl with murderous intent.

lines.zh: 大嘴张到最大，让你数清牙。
lines.en: My jaws open wide enough for you to count the teeth.

lines.zh: 鼻孔张合，记下你的味道。
lines.en: My nostrils flare, recording your smell.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，头贴近地面。
lines.en: I lower my body, head near the ground.

lines.zh: 骨骼嘎吱作响，我受伤了。
lines.en: The bones creak. I'm hurt.
This body is hurt.
My muscles tremble. I'm hurt.
Torn flesh, I'm hurt.
Battered and bruised, I'm hurt.
Scaly wounds, I'm hurt.
Wounds ache, I'm hurt.
Joints hurt, I'm hurt.
My sinews are broken. I'm hurt.
My ribs are broken. I'm hurt.

lines.zh: 巨大颚骨咬向你，快闪开！
lines.en: Large jaws bite at you, dodge!

lines.zh: 你的气味吸引了我，靠近点。
lines.en: Your scent draws me near.

lines.zh: 我庞大的身躯需要更多肉类。
lines.en: My body needs more meat.
Is your flesh tasty?

lines.zh: 别害怕，我不会伤害你的。
lines.en: Don't fear, I won't harm you.

lines.zh: 你若驯服我，可获强大力量。
lines.en: Tame me, gain great power.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片坚硬如铁，无法穿透。
lines.en: My scales are tough as iron.

lines.zh: 靠近些，我会考虑放过你。
lines.en: Come closer, I might spare you.

lines.zh: 你能否驯服一只真正的龙？
lines.en: Can you tame a true dragon?

lines.zh: 我的力量能碾碎你的意志。
lines.en: My strength crushes your will.
My horn will fling you!
Avoid my collision!
My body is a steel bull!
Beware my sudden charge!

lines.zh: 巨大的体型让我难以操控。
lines.en: My massive size makes me hard to control.
You can't stop my power.

lines.zh: 我用撞击粉碎你的防御。
lines.en: I crush your defense with impact.
My strength shakes the earth.
You can't escape, I'm colliding!
My body is a steel wall!
My mate will soon arrive.
During courtship, I'll spare you.
My roar calls my mate.

lines.zh: 我咬断一根树枝，放在巢边。
lines.en: I snap a branch and lay it by the nest.

lines.zh: 我的背脊竖起来，是给你看的。
lines.en: I arch my spine so that you can see it.
My strength will protect you.
You needn't fear me during courtship.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣会给你带来好运。
lines.en: My mate brings you good fortune.

lines.zh: 求爱时，我会展现我的美丽。
lines.en: During courtship, I show my beauty.

lines.zh: 我的力量将保护你与我。
lines.en: My strength protects you and me.

lines.zh: 庞大身躯压过地面，低吼声回荡山谷。
lines.en: Rumbles fill the valley as it steps heavily.

lines.zh: 石缝中探出巨大头颅，发出震耳欲聋的咆哮。
lines.en: A mighty roar echoes from within a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 锋利牙齿对准猎物，露出嗜血的笑容。
lines.en: Sharp teeth glint in the sunlight, signaling a meal.

lines.zh: 巨大翅膀轻轻扇动，阴影笼罩下方。
lines.en: Giant wings flap, casting shadows below.

lines.zh: 沉重脚步声渐近，警惕地注视着。
lines.en: Heavy footsteps approach, eyes narrowing.

lines.zh: 巨颚张开，喷出灼热气息。
lines.en: The giant jaw opens, releasing a blast of heat.

lines.zh: 铁甲覆盖身躯，宛如不朽之躯。
lines.en: Its ironhide armor makes it seem invincible.

lines.zh: 长尾甩动，尘土飞扬，威势震慑四方。
lines.en: A long tail swings, sending dust flying.

lines.zh: 低垂着头颅，仿佛在沉思。
lines.en: It lowers its head, as if in thought.

lines.zh: 爪子划过地面，留下深深痕迹。
lines.en: Claws dig deep into the ground as they walk.

lines.zh: 视野中出现猎物，眼睛中掠过贪婪的光芒。
lines.en: Its gaze locks on prey, eyes gleaming with hunger.

lines.zh: 敏锐的鼻孔嗅到猎物的气息。
lines.en: Its nostrils flare, scenting prey.

lines.zh: 目光扫视四周，寻找猎物踪迹。
lines.en: It scans the area for prey.

lines.zh: 喉咙发出低鸣，宣告狩猎开始。
lines.en: It emits a low growl, signaling the hunt.

lines.zh: 舌头舔了舔嘴唇，唾液分泌。
lines.en: Its tongue licks its lips, saliva dripping.

lines.zh: 耳朵转动，注意周围声音。
lines.en: Ears twitch, listening for sounds.

lines.zh: 前肢抬起，准备捕捉猎物。
lines.en: It raises its forelimbs, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 眼眸中露出凶狠的神色。
lines.en: Its eyes become fierce and predatory.

lines.zh: 后肢发力，准备冲向猎物。
lines.en: It powers up its hind legs, ready to pounce.
Its teeth clack together, making a grinding sound.

lines.zh: 你脚下的震动惊动了我。
lines.en: Your footfalls shook me awake.
Your size is a day's meal.
I smell blood, and it is yours.
Foreclaws raised, I fix on you.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，目光紧随其后。
lines.en: Target locked, eyes tracking it.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴压低，准备起跳。
lines.en: I drop my tail low and get ready to spring.

lines.zh: 我一低头，颈部肌肉绷紧。
lines.en: I dip my head and the muscles of my neck knot.
Target locked, claws tensed.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，堵住你左侧的路。
lines.en: I turn sideways to cut off your left side.
Target locked, jaw closing.
Target locked, flames aimed.
Target locked, eyes fixed on it.

lines.zh: 大嘴张开，先量你的脖子。
lines.en: Jaws wide, I measure your neck.
Target locked, wings moving.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾在泥里抓出深痕。
lines.en: My toes gouge deep marks into the mud.
A low rumble rolls out of my throat.

lines.zh: 我横过身，挡住你的退路。
lines.en: I turn broadside to cut your retreat.
My teeth clack as if testing a blade.

lines.zh: 你往哪跑，我的头就转向哪。
lines.en: Wherever you run, my head turns.
Giant claws, deafening roar!
Sharp claws,致命打击!
Rip through air, fierce attack!
Roar shakes the mountain,扑向猎物!
Growls, bites fiercely, lunges!
Large jaw, deadly kiss!
Tongue licks, agony follows!
Swinging huge hands, ground trembles!
Ravage, everything devoured!
Giant claws rip, bloody mess!
My jaws snap shut and splinter wood.

lines.zh: 前爪一拍，你被按进土里。
lines.en: One foreclaw slams you into the dirt.
My tail sweeps you off your feet.
Fangs tear a strip from your shoulder.
Egg cracks, dragon emerges!
Cave depths, giant hatches!
Lightning strikes, giant born!
Ancient nest, dragon hatches!
Deep underground, hatches!
Lava cavern, giant hatches!
Thunderstorm night, hatches!
Secret cave, dragon hatches!
Dark cave, giant hatches!
Lava rock, hatches!

lines.zh: 灌木被撞开，我走了出来。
lines.en: Brush bursts apart and I step out.
At the marsh's edge I lift my head.
One long roar drowns the insects.

lines.zh: 我从河岸的雾气里显形。
lines.en: I form out of riverside mist.

lines.zh: 这片林地本来就是我的。
lines.en: These woods were always mine.

lines.zh: 脚印先在泥里，然后是我。
lines.en: Prints in the mud first, then me.
A huge shadow nears and trees bend.

lines.zh: 在我之前，只有骨头的味道。
lines.en: Before me there was only the smell of bone.

lines.zh: 炙热的火焰烧伤了我的皮肤。
lines.en: The flames burn my skin.

lines.zh: 从高处跌落，骨头受伤了。
lines.en: Fell from a height. Bones hurt.
Drowned. Lungs hurt.

lines.zh: 爆炸冲击波撕裂了我的肌肉。
lines.en: Explosion ruptures my muscles.

lines.zh: 箭头卡在我的肋骨之间。
lines.en: The arrowhead is lodged between my ribs.
Magic burns my scales.
This big frame can't hold up.
Lightning rips through my flesh.
The void drains my strength.
